💡 **SUGGESTION: Not `dart format`-clean**

`dart format --output=none --set-exit-if-changed` under the current SDK (3.13.5) reflows two spots in this new file. The `_chord` helper collapses:

```diff
-TeaKey _chord(String letter) => TeaKey(
-  code: KeyCode.rune,
-  text: letter,
-  modifiers: const {KeyMod.ctrl},
-);
+TeaKey _chord(String letter) =>
+    TeaKey(code: KeyCode.rune, text: letter, modifiers: const {KeyMod.ctrl});
```

and the long test name at line 63 gets wrapped. The repo's pre-commit hook self-heals staged Dart files (`scripts/pre-commit:39-41` runs `dart format` + re-stage), so this file likely landed without the hook running.

Purely mechanical: `dart format test/cli/fa_tui_slash_menu_chord_test.dart`. Polish only — there is no CI format gate and sibling test files carry the same drift (e.g. `test/cli/fa_tui_paste_flow_test.dart`, landed 2026-10-14, is also dirty under the current SDK), so the tree tolerates it; noting it so the next touch of the file doesn't produce a noisy format-only diff.

comments.author: unknown
comments.body:
💡 **SUGGESTION: Tests 3 & 5 couple to `/memory` existing in `builtinSlashCommands`**

The regression tests drive the real production path (`buildSlashMenuItems` + `builtinSlashCommands`), which is good end-to-end coverage — but tests 3 and 5 hard-assert the catalog contains `/memory` (`line 80` and `line 103`'s `firstWhere`). If that command is ever renamed or removed, these chord-regression tests break for a reason unrelated to the chord guard and need a follow-up edit.

The `buildSlashMenu` callback is already wired in `_model()`; returning a fixed 2–3 item list there (as several `test/cli/fa_tui_test.dart` cases do with `buildSlashMenu: (_) => const [...]`) would pin the regression strictly to the chord behavior, independent of the command catalog.

Keeping the real builder is also defensible — the 2+ item flow through the real filter is exactly the reported failure shape. A lighter alternative that keeps that coverage: assert the item list is UNCHANGED across the chord (snapshot `model.menuItems` before/after) instead of naming a specific command. Either way, polish only — the behavior asserted today is correct and the tests are green.
